# KovaGPT

> KovaGPT is an AI workspace for conversational drafting, coding help, web-assisted answers, research, and image generation.

KovaGPT is one unified assistant. Model selection and response effort are separate concepts. Only capabilities confirmed by the deployed runtime are available. Future model names or plan entitlements do not establish serving availability. Max remains single-agent; only an authorized Ultra request may use subagents. Voice input is not currently part of the supported web product. Search, research, connected apps, and image generation depend on configured providers and account access. Scheduled tasks require an enabled worker and account access.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Start a conversation with KovaGPT and attach supported files when available.
- [Images](/images): Generate images when an image provider is configured.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Compare Free, Plus, and Pro plans.
- [Apps](/apps): Review the connections currently available to your account.
